shots.action: Mechanical plates unfold and slide across the subject's body, clicking into place one by one until a sleek armored suit covers them and thin lines glow to life.
shots.sound: Whirring servos, metallic clicks and a final power-up hum.

end.paint: Dress the person in a sleek original high-tech armored suit with matte black and brushed steel plates and thin glowing lines, no logos or emblems, face uncovered. Keep the same person, face, pose, framing, background and lighting.
